description.short: Celtic Canoes offers self-guided canoe hire and multi-day expedition trips on the River Wye, launching from The Boat House in Glasbury on the England/Wales border. Half-day, full-day, and 2–5-day trips are available, all including transport back to the start point.
description.shortNote: Drafted from verified website content. Needs editorial review. The address is technically in England (HR3 5NP); editorial guidance needed on how to handle this in the directory description.
description.full:
Celtic Canoes specialises in canoe hire and expedition trips on one of Britain's most scenic rivers. Based at The Boat House in Glasbury — on the border of Wales and Herefordshire — the company operates open-top canoes for two or three paddlers on the River Wye, a Site of Special Scientific Interest and European Special Area for Conservation.

Choices range from a half-day paddle (5–5.5 miles, approximately 2–3 hours) to a full-day trip (approximately 11 miles, 4–5 hours) and multi-day self-guided expeditions of 2–5 days covering up to 60 miles of river, from Glasbury downstream to Ross-on-Wye. All trips include a buoyancy aid, paddle, dry barrel, dry bag, guidance maps, and a return shuttle to the launch point. Additional accommodation options are available through partner campsites and the Wye Valley Bunkhouse, an 18-bed converted Grade II listed Welsh chapel at Glasbury.

The company does not permit solo paddling (safety requirement) and requires a minimum age of 10, with a 1:1 adult-to-child ratio. Dogs are welcome on board. Celtic Canoes holds AALA (Adventure Activities Licensing Authority) accreditation and operates in line with British Canoeing and Natural Resources Wales guidelines for access on the River Wye.
description.fullNote: Drafted from verified website content at celticcanoes.co.uk (June 2026). Pricing omitted from full description — see pricing section. The Grade II chapel claim and AALA accreditation are from the live website but should be independently verified before publishing. The 'no solo paddling' and 'minimum age 10' rules are from the live FAQs page.

claimsNeedingHumanReview.issue: The Boat House, Glasbury, HR3 5NP is in Herefordshire, England. Glasbury sits on the England/Wales border — the River Wye is the county boundary. The physical location of the canoe centre is on the English bank. The operator serves the River Wye corridor through Wales and the Welsh Marches, and is listed in the directory under a Welsh region (Wye Valley / Mid Wales). This may affect eligibility for the Adventure Wales directory.
